test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 10 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: The Communist Party of India was founded at ________ in October 1920.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tashkent**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• After the second Comintern Congress, M.N. Roy, Abani Mukherji, and others founded the Communist Party of India (CPI).
 
• It was founded in 1920 in Tashkent (now the capital of Uzbekistan).
 
• M.N. Roy was the first elected Comintern leader.
 
• The Communist conference in which CPI was formed was held at Kanpur in the same location at which the congress session was held.
 
• The Communist Conference was convened by Satya Bhakt.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Communist Party of India (Marxist) or CPI (M) **emerged when it split from the Communist Party of India in **1964**.
 
• The flag of the Party is a red flag of which the length is one-and-a-half times its width.
 
• At the centre of the flag, there is a crossed hammer and sickle in white.
 
• All membership records are kept under the supervision of the District Committee. 
 
• CPI(M) is a leading party in the Kerela state. Party's headquarters is in New Delhi
 
• Sitaram Yechury is the General Secretary of the party and A. M. Ariff is its Lok Sabha leader.
